node.title: Re: PerlCGI + Apache ldap authentication configuration
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I'm not an expert on LDAP so I don't know if the differences between the Apache config and your command-line version are relevant? (In particular, -D "DOMAIN\user_id" -W vs. AuthLDAPBindDN "CN=user_id,DC=DOMAIN,DC=com".) [https://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/mod/mod_authnz_ldap.html|mod_authnz_ldap] also has a whole bunch more configuration options. Anyway, since you don't appear to be using an encrypted LDAP connection (?), could you try just sniffing it using [http://www.wireshark.org/|Wireshark] or [man://tcpdump] and compare what Apache is doing with what [man://ldapsearch] is doing.
